title: Commit preparation preserves independent DVito repository ownership
summary: The owner requested committing all work. Project DVito is an independent nested Git checkout with its own origin and untracked supplier design sources; the main workspace holds the standalone dvendo-supply project, source bundle, preview task and new notes. Added a parent ignore entry for the independent checkout to prevent an embedded Git link without a submodule definition. Design work will be committed in its own repository, and the standalone starter and notes in the main repository. Fourteen synthetic redesign-model tests and clean-project documentation/provenance checks passed. No live account, payment or deployment is verified by these checks. This step creates local commits only. An initial recorder attempt rejected a hidden-file evidence path; the record now uses visible source evidence.

evidence.description: Fourteen offline tests passed during commit preparation.
Portable guide links and historical evidence checks passed.
Standalone project remains portable and separate from the original DVito checkout.

nextSteps: Create and inspect local commits in both repositories; report commit IDs and working-tree state.
